hook: There's No Good or Bad Luck

voices.name: l00
voices.text: When the old farmer's horse ran away, <#0.2#> the villagers said: bad luck.
voices.caption: When the old farmer's horse ran away, the villagers said: bad luck.

voices.name: l01
voices.text: When it came back with a wild horse, <#0.2#> they said: good luck.
voices.caption: When it came back with a wild horse, they said: good luck.

voices.name: l02
voices.text: His son fell from it and broke his leg. Bad luck. <#0.3#> Then soldiers came, and his son was spared.
voices.caption: His son fell from it and broke his leg. Bad luck. Then soldiers came, and his son was spared.

voices.name: l04
voices.text: There's no right answer. <#0.2#> You choose what it means.
voices.caption: There's no right answer. You choose what it means.

voices.name: l05
voices.text: Even what you're going through right now.
voices.caption: Even what you're going through right now.
